The Clean Water Act, 2006 legislation requires watershed boundaries for both Source Water Protection Regions (SPR's) and Source Water Protection Authorities (SPA’s). This layer defines the jurisdictional boundary for the Central Lake Ontario Source Protection Authority. The boundary were created using a 'scientific' watershed delineation approach that drew upon a hybrid of data sources.
